purpose: Exploratory strongest-baseline challenge fixed before executing this new grid
hypothesis: Paired feature retention can require two additions that one-add local exchange misses and explicit concat caching can remove that gap
accounting: Same captured bytes and metadata and declared fault contract for all methods; robust heuristics compared at full candidate budget and published materializers at exact minimum budget
manual_control: Choose smallest feasible of roots plus all view outputs or roots plus all model and probability targets or roots plus shared concat when present
limitations: Constructed diagnostic histories motivated by inspection of the baseline
Two-view grouping is an adaptation rather than independently collected multimodal production data
No universal dominance or new min-cut theory claim
Native DVC is not rerun in this experiment and the manual frontier is a retention-set control
cloud_scope: Fresh captures and replay on this GitHub runner; one fixed seed block of the complete grid
